synopsis: Exodus appears in Empyrean Seat and the Esper fight begins to Esper Battle (track 71).
plays_when: in Empyrean Seat (Mosphoran Highwaste), when the party arrives while Exodus is undefeated (the battle byte, global byte 0xA23, is 1 from the new game, pre_z0000 line 278, until the win): Exodus appears and the battle begins (mnt_c01 lines 334 and 338 under the test at line 328). The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (line 272) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (lines 295 and 306).

synopsis: Exodus falls in Empyrean Seat and the party gains the Esper Exodus.
items: receives Belias; receives SecondJob; receives Zalera; receives Mateus; receives Exodus; receives Shemhazai; receives Hashmal; receives Famfrit; receives Cúchulainn; receives Adrammelech; receives Zodiark; receives Zeromus; receives Chaos; receives Ultima
plays_when: in Empyrean Seat (Mosphoran Highwaste), when Exodus is defeated: the script starts it on arrival together with the opening scene (mnt_c01 lines 336 and 339 under the test at line 328), and it holds (mnt_c0101 line 59) until the script releases it after the win (mnt_c01 line 460), and the win sets the battle byte (global byte 0xA23) to 2 (mnt_c01 line 639), so neither scene plays again. The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (line 272) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (lines 295 and 306).
